verdict.rationale: Latham documents an early-stage/emerging companies practice with explicit seed/angel financing language, a glossary including SAFE and convertible-note terms, and a notable convertible note document generator (built with ConsenSys) for startups raising capital. However, there's no dedicated SAFE/convertible-instrument explainer or article specifically walking founders through pre-seed/seed deal mechanics — the SAFE reference is just a glossary entry, not a stated practice deep-dive. Missing for 10: a published SAFE/convertible note explainer or guide, sample forms beyond the automated note generator, and articles specifically addressing pre-seed/seed round structuring.
